title: Dispatching a spare water meter
passage:
Man: I’ve got one spare meter in the van. Vale Court hasn’t sent readings all week, and Dean House’s laundry meter has been showing the same total.
Woman: We swap a meter only if it has stopped counting. If the number on its own display is still rising, we check the connection to the office first.
Man: Kim watched Vale’s display while water was running. The total went up, even though nothing appeared on our office screen.
Woman: For a replacement, the form needs the last total someone verified while the old meter was still counting, and the serial number of the unit that produced it.
Man: At Dean House, running water didn’t change the display at all. Kim has the last verified total on yesterday’s worksheet, but didn’t copy the serial number. It’s printed on the old unit.
Woman: Read it before taking the meter out. Bring that unit to our workshop, not the scrap depot. I want to see whether it behaves the same way on the test loop.
passageZh:
男：我車上有一只備用水表。維爾庭院這整週都沒傳來讀數，迪恩大樓洗衣間的水表則一直顯示同一個累積數字。
女：只有水表不再計量，我們才會更換。如果水表本身顯示的數字還在增加，我們會先檢查它和辦公室之間的連線。
男：金在維爾庭院放水時盯著水表看。累積數字確實增加，但辦公室的螢幕仍沒有收到資料。
女：要換表時，表單須填舊水表還在計量時最後一次經過確認的累積讀數，以及產生這個讀數的那只舊水表的序號。
男：迪恩大樓那邊放水時，水表顯示的數字完全沒有變。金昨天的工作單記了最後一次經過確認的讀數，但沒抄序號。序號印在舊水表上。
女：拆下水表前先抄序號。把那只舊水表帶回我們的工作室，不要送去報廢場。我想看看它接上測試管路後，會不會出現一樣的情況。
